narrator.description: A warm, gentle American woman in her late sixties telling the true story of her own life, like a beloved audiobook narrator. Soft Pennsylvania accent, calm and intimate, a little husky with age, quietly emotional, never theatrical. Sounds like a grandmother talking to a friend late at night.

charles.description: A frail, wealthy American man in his mid seventies, a retired small-town banker. Refined, once commanding voice now weak, breathy and trembling with guilt and fear. Old-fashioned East Coast polish.
